lessons.title: 她请我们吃了北京烤鸭

points.name: 语气助词“吧”（2）：猜测、确认
points.explainEn: Use 吧 at the end when you make a guess or ask for confirmation.
points.structure: 陈述句 + 吧？

examples.en: You are a new classmate, right?
examples.py: Nǐ shì xīn tóng xué ba?

examples.en: He is your teacher, right?
examples.py: Tā shì nǐ de lǎo shī ba?

examples.en: You are coming tomorrow too, right?
examples.py: Nǐ míng tiān yě lái ba?

exercises.q: 翻译：You're Wang Fang's younger sister, right?
exercises.body: You're Wang Fang's younger sister, right?

exercises.q: 翻译：You're tired, right?
exercises.body: You're tired, right?

points.note: 第一册“吧（1）”主要表示建议；这里的“吧（2）”表示说话人有一个猜测，希望对方确认。
points.structureEn: Statement + ba? (guess / confirmation)
points.noteEn: Book 1's 吧(1) suggests; 吧(2) here marks a guess seeking confirmation.

points.name: “是……的”句
points.explainEn: Use 是…的 to emphasize the time, place, way, person, or purpose of a completed event.
points.structure: 主语 +（是）+ 强调信息 + 动词 + 的

examples.en: I came by subway.
examples.py: Wǒ shì zuò dì tiě lái de.

examples.en: A friend gave me this book.
examples.py: Zhè běn shū shì péng you sòng de.

examples.en: We came here to travel.
examples.py: Wǒ men shì lái lǚ yóu de.

exercises.q: 翻译：I bought this phone online. (stress WHERE you bought it)
exercises.a: 这个手机是我在网上买的。
exercises.body: I bought this phone online. (stress WHERE you bought it)

exercises.q: 翻译：When did you come? (it already happened)
exercises.body: When did you come? (it already happened)

exercises.q: 翻译：Who did you come with? (it already happened)
exercises.body: Who did you come with? (it already happened)

points.note: 肯定句中的“是”有时可以省略；本级先掌握最常见的强调方式、人物和目的。
points.structureEn: Subject + (shì) + Emphasized information + Verb + de
points.noteEn: 是 can be dropped in positive sentences; focus on stressing manner, person and purpose.

points.name: 兼语句
points.explainEn: Use 请/让/叫 + person + verb to ask or make someone do something.
points.structure: 主语 + 请/让/叫 + 人 + 动词（短语）

examples.en: The teacher asks us to speak Chinese.
examples.py: Lǎo shī ràng wǒ men shuō zhōng wén.

examples.en: Mom tells me to go home early.
examples.py: Mā ma jiào wǒ zǎo diǎnr huí jiā.

examples.en: I would like to ask you for a favor.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng qǐng nǐ bāng ge máng.

exercises.q: 翻译：The teacher asked me to write ten characters.
exercises.body: The teacher asked me to write ten characters.

exercises.q: 翻译：Mom asked me to buy some fruit.
exercises.body: Mom asked me to buy some fruit.

exercises.q: 翻译：I'm inviting you to see a movie. (use 请)
exercises.body: I'm inviting you to see a movie. (use 请)

points.note: “请、让、叫”后的“人”既是前一个动词的宾语，也是后一个动作的执行者。
points.structureEn: Subject + qǐng / ràng / jiào + Person + Verb (Phrase)
points.noteEn: After 请/让/叫, the person is both object of the first verb and doer of the next.

points.name: 固定格式“还是……吧”
points.explainEn: Use 还是…吧 to say “it would be better to…” or “let’s…instead”.
points.structure: 还是 + 动词（短语）+ 吧

examples.en: Let’s take a taxi instead.
examples.py: Wǒ men hái shì dǎ chē qù ba.

examples.zh: 太晚了，还是明天再去吧。
examples.en: It is too late. Let’s go tomorrow instead.
examples.py: Tài wǎn le, hái shì míng tiān zài qù ba.

examples.zh: 你累了，还是休息一下吧。
examples.en: You are tired. You had better take a rest.
examples.py: Nǐ lèi le, hái shì xiū xi yí xià ba.

exercises.q: 翻译：It's too cold. Let's just watch TV at home instead.
exercises.a: 太冷了，还是在家看电视吧。
exercises.body: It's too cold. Let's just watch TV at home instead.

exercises.q: 翻译：This one is too expensive. Let's buy that one instead.
exercises.a: 这个太贵了，还是买那个吧。
exercises.body: This one is too expensive. Let's buy that one instead.

points.note: 表示在几种可能中认为这个选择更合适。
points.structureEn: háishi + Verb (Phrase) + ba (better / instead)
points.noteEn: Marks this option as the more suitable among possibilities.

points.name: 用“多”表达概数
points.explainEn: Put 多 after a number or measure phrase to mean “a little more than…”.
points.structure: 整十/百等 + 多 + 量词；数词 + 量词 + 多

examples.zh: 教室里有二十多个学生。
examples.en: There are more than twenty students in the classroom.
examples.py: Jiào shì lǐ yǒu èr shí duō ge xué sheng.

examples.en: This book costs a little over thirty yuan.
examples.py: Zhè běn shū sān shí duō kuài qián.

examples.en: I waited for more than ten minutes.
examples.py: Wǒ děng le shí duō fēn zhōng.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older brother is over thirty.
exercises.body: My older brother is over thirty.

exercises.q: 翻译：I studied Chinese for over two years.
exercises.body: I studied Chinese for over two years.

points.note: “多”表示超过前面的数字一点儿，不表示精确数量。
points.structureEn: Round number (10/100...) + duō + Measure Word; Number + Measure Word + duō
points.noteEn: 多 means a bit more than the number, not an exact amount.

points.name: 动词、动词性短语、主谓短语作定语
points.pinyin: dòngcí, dòngcíxìng duǎnyǔ, zhǔwèi duǎnyǔ zuò dìngyǔ
points.explainEn: Put a verb or phrase + 的 before a noun to describe which person or thing you mean.
points.structure: 动词/短语 + 的 + 名词

examples.en: This is the book I bought.
examples.py: Zhè shì wǒ mǎi de shū.

examples.en: There are many students who study Chinese.
examples.py: Xué zhōng wén de xué sheng hěn duō.

examples.en: This is the cup my friend gave me.
examples.py: Zhè shì péng you gěi wǒ de bēi zi.

exercises.q: 翻译：The dumplings Mom makes are very tasty.
exercises.body: The dumplings Mom makes are very tasty.

exercises.q: 翻译：The person who came yesterday is my friend.
exercises.body: The person who came yesterday is my friend.

points.note: 定语较长时通常要用“的”。
points.structureEn: Verb / Phrase + de + Noun
points.noteEn: Use 的 when the modifier is long.

points.name: 结果补语
points.explainEn: Put a result word after a verb to show what result the action reaches.
points.structure: 动词 + 好/完/懂/到/见……

examples.en: The food is ready.
examples.py: Fàn zuò hǎo le.

examples.en: I finished eating.
examples.py: Wǒ chī wán fàn le.

examples.en: I understood this word.
examples.py: Zhè ge zì wǒ tīng dǒng le.

exercises.q: 翻译：I've finished reading this book.
exercises.body: I've finished reading this book.

exercises.q: 翻译：Did you understand? (listening)
exercises.body: Did you understand? (listening)

exercises.q: 翻译：I found my phone.
exercises.body: I found my phone.

points.note: 常见结果补语：好、完、懂、到、见、错等；否定常用“没 + 动词 + 结果补语”。
points.structureEn: Verb + Result Complement (hǎo / wán / dǒng / dào / jiàn...)
points.noteEn: Common result complements: 好/完/懂/到/见/错; negate with 没 + verb + complement.

points.name: 动词重叠（1）：未完成/一般动作
points.explainEn: Repeat a verb to make the action short, light, or like “try it”.
points.structure: A（一）A；ABAB；离合词 AAB

examples.en: Take a look at this book.
examples.py: Nǐ kàn kàn zhè běn shū.

examples.en: Let me think for a moment.
examples.py: Ràng wǒ xiǎng yì xiǎng.

examples.en: I want to rest for a while.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng xiū xi xiū xi.

exercises.q: 翻译：Can I try it on? (repeat the verb)
exercises.body: Can I try it on? (repeat the verb)

exercises.q: 翻译：Please introduce yourself a little. (repeat the verb)
exercises.body: Please introduce yourself a little. (repeat the verb)

exercises.q: 翻译：Let's sing a little. (repeat the verb)
exercises.body: Let's sing a little. (repeat the verb)

points.note: 表示动作时间短、次数少或尝试一下，语气比较轻松。
points.structureEn: A(yī)A; ABAB; Separable verb: AAB
points.noteEn: Marks a brief/few-times/tentative action, in a casual tone.

points.name: 动词重叠（2）：已完成动作
points.explainEn: For a completed short action, use forms such as A了A or AB了一下.
points.structure: A了A；AB了一下；离合词 A了AB

examples.en: I took a quick look at my phone.
examples.py: Wǒ kàn le kàn shǒu jī.

examples.en: I rested for a little while.
examples.py: Wǒ xiū xi le yí xià.

examples.en: He came and helped for a bit.
examples.py: Tā lái bāng le bāng máng.

exercises.q: 翻译：He tried on that pair of trousers.
exercises.body: He tried on that pair of trousers.

exercises.q: 翻译：I washed my hands quickly. (repeat the verb)
exercises.body: I washed my hands quickly. (repeat the verb)

exercises.q: 翻译：I briefly introduced myself. (use 一下)
exercises.body: I briefly introduced myself. (use 一下)

points.note: 和“动词重叠（1）”相比，本点强调动作已经发生。
points.structureEn: A le A; AB le yíxià; Separable verb: A le AB
points.noteEn: Unlike verb reduplication (1), this stresses the action already happened.

points.name: 动态助词“过”
points.explainEn: Use 过 after a verb to say you have had an experience before.
points.structure: 主语 + 动词 + 过 + 宾语

examples.en: I have been to Beijing.
examples.py: Wǒ qù guo běi jīng.

examples.en: I have eaten Peking Duck.
examples.py: Wǒ chī guo běi jīng kǎo yā.

examples.en: She has never seen this movie.
examples.py: Tā méi kàn guo zhè ge diàn yǐng.

exercises.q: 翻译：I've never eaten dumplings.
exercises.body: I've never eaten dumplings.

exercises.q: 翻译：Have you ever taken a plane?
exercises.body: Have you ever taken a plane?

points.note: 否定常用“没（有）+ 动词 + 过”。
points.structureEn: Subject + Verb + guo (experience marker) + Object
points.noteEn: Negate with 没(有) + verb + 过.

points.name: 因果复句“因为……，所以……”
points.explainEn: Use 因为…所以… for “because…so…”.
points.structure: 因为 + 原因，所以 + 结果

examples.en: Because it rained, I did not go.
examples.py: Yīn wèi xià yǔ, suǒ yǐ wǒ méi qù.

examples.zh: 因为我很累，所以想休息。
examples.en: Because I am tired, I want to rest.
examples.py: Yīn wèi wǒ hěn lèi, suǒ yǐ xiǎng xiū xi.

examples.zh: 因为她喜欢红色，所以买了红色的。
examples.en: Because she likes red, she bought the red one.
examples.py: Yīn wèi tā xǐ huan hóng sè, suǒ yǐ mǎi le hóng sè de.

exercises.q: 翻译：Because it's too expensive, I didn't buy it.
exercises.a: 因为太贵了，所以我没买。
exercises.body: Because it's too expensive, I didn't buy it.

exercises.q: 翻译：Because I was sick, I didn't go to class.
exercises.a: 因为我生病了，所以没去上课。
exercises.body: Because I was sick, I didn't go to class.

points.note: 初学先掌握完整结构；口语中有时可省略其中一个关联词。
points.structureEn: yīnwèi + Reason, suǒyǐ + Result (because...so...)
points.noteEn: Learn the full pattern first; speech may drop one connective.

points.name: “的”字短语
points.explainEn: When the noun is already clear, you can use “…的” alone to mean “the … one”.
points.structure: 修饰语 + 的

examples.en: I like the red one.
examples.py: Wǒ xǐ huan hóng sè de.

examples.en: This one is mine.
examples.py: Zhè běn shì wǒ de.

examples.en: I want to buy a cheaper one.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi pián yi yì diǎnr de.

exercises.q: 翻译：That big one is my older brother's.
exercises.body: That big one is my older brother's.

exercises.q: 翻译：Is this phone yours?
exercises.body: Is this phone yours?

points.note: “的”后面的中心名词已经清楚时可以省略。
points.structureEn: Modifier + de = “the ... one”
points.noteEn: The head noun after 的 can be dropped when it's already clear.

points.name: 简单趋向补语（1）
points.explainEn: Use 来 for movement toward the speaker and 去 for movement away from the speaker.
points.structure: 动词 + 来 / 去

examples.en: Please come in.
examples.py: Qǐng jìn lái.

examples.en: He walked out.
examples.py: Tā zǒu chū qù le.

examples.en: Bring the book here.
examples.py: Nǐ bǎ shū ná lái.

exercises.q: 翻译：Please come down.
exercises.body: Please come down.

exercises.q: 翻译：He went back.
exercises.body: He went back.

points.note: 先掌握“来=朝说话人方向，去=离开说话人方向”。
points.structureEn: Verb + lái / qù (toward / away from the speaker)
points.noteEn: First learn 来 = toward the speaker, 去 = away from the speaker.

points.name: 简单趋向补语（2）：带宾语
points.explainEn: When a direction complement has an object, the object position depends on whether it is a place or a thing.
points.structure: 地点：V + 地点 + 来/去；事物：V + 来/去 + 事物 / V + 事物 + 来/去

examples.en: Come into the classroom quickly.
examples.py: Kuài jìn jiào shì lái ba.

examples.en: Dad brought back a lot of fruit.
examples.py: Bà ba mǎi huí le hěn duō shuǐ guǒ.

examples.en: She brought me a book.
examples.py: Tā gěi wǒ sòng lái le yì běn shū.

exercises.q: 翻译：Mom brought over a cup of tea.
exercises.body: Mom brought over a cup of tea.

exercises.q: 翻译：He went back to school. (use 回…去)
exercises.body: He went back to school. (use 回…去)

points.note: 地点名词通常放在“来/去”前；事物宾语的位置更灵活。
points.structureEn: Place: V + Place + lái/qù; Thing: V + lái/qù + Thing OR V + Thing + lái/qù
points.noteEn: A place noun goes before 来/去; a thing object is more flexible.

points.name: 固定格式“都……了”
points.explainEn: Use 都…了 to mean “already / it has reached this point”, often with emphasis.
points.structure: 都 + 时间/数量/情况 + 了

examples.zh: 都十二点了，我们吃饭吧。
examples.en: It is already twelve. Let’s eat.
examples.py: Dōu shí èr diǎn le, wǒ men chī fàn ba.

examples.zh: 都八点半了，你还不起床吗？
examples.en: It is already 8:30. Aren’t you getting up?
examples.py: Dōu bā diǎn bàn le, nǐ hái bù qǐ chuáng ma?

examples.en: The child is already ten.
examples.py: Hái zi dōu shí suì le.

exercises.q: 翻译：It's already ten o'clock; let's go home.
exercises.body: It's already ten o'clock; let's go home.

exercises.q: 翻译：I've already waited for an hour!
exercises.body: I've already waited for an hour!

points.note: 常带提醒、惊讶或不满意的语气。
points.structureEn: dōu + Time / Amount / Situation + le = “already...”
points.noteEn: Carries a reminding, surprised or displeased tone.

points.name: 形容词重叠
points.explainEn: Repeat an adjective to make the description more vivid or affectionate.
points.structure: A → AA；AB → AABB

examples.zh: 我想买一个大大的蛋糕。
examples.en: I want to buy a big cake.
examples.py: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yí ge dà dà de dàn gāo.

examples.en: This apple is nice and red.
examples.py: Zhè ge píng guǒ hóng hóng de.

examples.zh: 大家高高兴兴地回家了。
examples.en: Everyone went home happily.
examples.py: Dà jiā gāo gāo xìng xìng de huí jiā le.

exercises.q: 翻译：The child's hands are tiny.
exercises.body: The child's hands are tiny.

exercises.q: 翻译：Her eyes are nice and big.
exercises.body: Her eyes are nice and big.

exercises.q: 翻译：I want to have a nice, comfortable sleep. (use 舒舒服服)
exercises.a: 我想舒舒服服地睡一觉。
exercises.body: I want to have a nice, comfortable sleep. (use 舒舒服服)

points.note: 形容词重叠后一般不能再加“很、非常”。
points.structureEn: A → AA; AB → AABB (adjective reduplication)
points.noteEn: After reduplication, an adjective can't take 很/非常.

points.name: 固定短语“什么的”
points.explainEn: Use 什么的 after examples to mean “and things like that”.
points.structure: A、B什么的

examples.zh: 我喜欢苹果、香蕉什么的。
examples.en: I like apples, bananas, and things like that.
examples.py: Wǒ xǐ huan píng guǒ, xiāng jiāo shén me de.

examples.zh: 生日可以买蛋糕、花什么的。
examples.en: For a birthday, you can buy cake, flowers, and things like that.
examples.py: Shēng rì kě yǐ mǎi dàn gāo, huā shén me de.

examples.zh: 周末我们看看电影、逛逛街什么的。
examples.en: On weekends we watch movies, shop, and things like that.
examples.py: Zhōu mò wǒ men kàn kàn diàn yǐng, guàng guàng jiē shén me de.

exercises.q: 翻译：I like playing basketball, football and things like that.
exercises.a: 我喜欢打篮球、踢足球什么的。
exercises.body: I like playing basketball, football and things like that.

exercises.q: 翻译：At the supermarket I bought milk, eggs and things like that.
exercises.a: 我在超市买了牛奶、鸡蛋什么的。
exercises.body: At the supermarket I bought milk, eggs and things like that.

points.note: 表示只举几个例子，还有类似内容没有全部说出来。
points.structureEn: A, B + shénme de = A, B, and things like that
points.noteEn: Gives just a few examples, with more similar ones left unsaid.

points.name: 结构助词“地”
points.explainEn: Use 地 after a describing word or phrase before a verb: “…ly”.
points.structure: 形容词/短语 + 地 + 动词

examples.en: She said “thank you” happily.
examples.py: Tā gāo xìng de shuō: "xiè xie!"

examples.en: He walked home slowly.
examples.py: Tā màn màn de zǒu huí jiā.

examples.en: We study Chinese carefully.
examples.py: Wǒ men rèn zhēn de xué xí zhōng wén.

exercises.q: 翻译：He quickly finished his breakfast.
exercises.body: He quickly finished his breakfast.

exercises.q: 翻译：Please speak slowly. (use 慢慢)
exercises.body: Please speak slowly. (use 慢慢)

points.note: 简单记：修饰“怎么做一个动作”时，常用“……地 + 动词”。
points.structureEn: Adjective / Phrase + de + Verb (describes how the action is done)
points.noteEn: Simple rule: to modify how an action is done, use …地 + verb.

points.name: 紧缩复句“一……就……”
points.explainEn: Use 一…就… for “as soon as…”.
points.structure: 一 + 动作1，就 + 动作2

examples.zh: 我一到家就给妈妈打电话。
examples.en: I call Mom as soon as I get home.
examples.py: Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù gěi mā ma dǎ diàn huà.

examples.en: He goes to play basketball as soon as class ends.
examples.py: Tā yí xià kè jiù qù dǎ lán qiú.

examples.en: I understood as soon as I looked.
examples.py: Wǒ yí kàn jiù míng bai le.

exercises.q: 翻译：As soon as I get up, I drink a glass of water.
exercises.body: As soon as I get up, I drink a glass of water.

exercises.q: 翻译：As soon as it rains, I take a taxi.
exercises.body: As soon as it rains, I take a taxi.

points.note: 第二个动作通常紧接第一个动作发生。
points.structureEn: yī + Action 1, jiù + Action 2 = as soon as..., then...
points.noteEn: The second action usually happens right after the first.

points.name: 状态补语（1）
points.explainEn: Use 得 after a verb to describe how an action is done.
points.structure: 动词 + 得 + 形容词/短语

examples.en: He runs very fast.
examples.py: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài.

examples.en: She writes very well.
examples.py: Tā xiě de hěn hǎo.

examples.en: Everyone had a great time.
examples.py: Dà jiā wán de hěn gāo xìng.

exercises.q: 翻译：He sings very well.
exercises.body: He sings very well.

exercises.q: 翻译：She speaks very slowly.
exercises.body: She speaks very slowly.

exercises.q: 翻译：Did you sleep well?
exercises.body: Did you sleep well?

points.note: “得”后面说明动作的状态、程度或效果。
points.structureEn: Verb + de + Adjective / Phrase (state complement)
points.noteEn: After 得 comes the state, degree or effect of the action.

points.name: 状态补语（2）：动词带宾语
points.explainEn: If the verb has an object, move the object before the verb or repeat the verb before 得.
points.structure: V + O + V + 得 + 补语；O + V + 得 + 补语

examples.en: He plays basketball very well.
examples.py: Tā dǎ lán qiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.

examples.en: I write Chinese characters fairly well.
examples.py: Wǒ hàn zì xiě de hái kě yǐ.

examples.en: She swims very fast.
examples.py: Tā yóu yǒng yóu de hěn kuài.

exercises.q: 翻译：He cooks very well.
exercises.body: He cooks very well.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older brother speaks Chinese very well.
exercises.a: 我哥哥说中文说得很好。
exercises.body: My older brother speaks Chinese very well.

points.note: 动词有宾语时不能直接说“他打篮球得很好”。
points.structureEn: V + O + V + de + Complement; O + V + de + Complement
points.noteEn: With an object you can't say 他打篮球得很好 (repeat the verb).

lessons.title: 虽然你忘了，但是我记得

points.name: 比较句（1）：“A 比 B + 形容词”
points.explainEn: Use A 比 B + adjective to say A is more … than B.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词

examples.en: Today is colder than yesterday.
examples.py: Jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān lěng.

examples.en: My older sister is taller than me.
examples.py: Jiě jie bǐ wǒ gāo.

examples.en: Taking the subway is faster than taking the bus.
examples.py: Zuò dì tiě bǐ zuò gōng jiāo chē kuài.

exercises.q: 翻译：This room is bigger than that one.
exercises.body: This room is bigger than that one.

exercises.q: 翻译：Coffee is more expensive than tea.
exercises.body: Coffee is more expensive than tea.

points.note: 最基本的“比”字比较句。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + Adjective = A is more ... than B
points.noteEn: The most basic 比 comparison sentence.

points.name: 比较句（2）：“比 + 更 / 还 + 形容词”
points.explainEn: In a 比 sentence, use 更 or 还 before the adjective for “even more”. Do not use 很/非常 there.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 更/还 + 形容词

examples.en: Today is even colder than yesterday.
examples.py: Jīn tiān bǐ zuó tiān gèng lěng.

examples.en: This one is even cheaper than that one.
examples.py: Zhè ge bǐ nà ge hái pián yi.

examples.en: She likes Chinese even more than I do.
examples.py: Tā bǐ wǒ gèng xǐ huan zhōng wén.

exercises.q: 翻译：Taking the subway is even faster than taking a taxi.
exercises.body: Taking the subway is even faster than taking a taxi.

exercises.q: 翻译：My younger sister is even taller than my older sister. (use 更)
exercises.body: My younger sister is even taller than my older sister. (use 更)

points.note: “比”字句的形容词前一般不用“很、非常”，可以用“更、还”。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + gèng / hái + Adjective = even more...
points.noteEn: In a 比 sentence use 更/还, not 很/非常, before the adjective.

points.name: 转折复句“虽然……，但是……”
points.explainEn: Use 虽然…但是… for “although…but…”.
points.structure: 虽然 + 情况，但是 + 转折结果

examples.zh: 虽然今天很冷，但是我还是想出去。
examples.en: Although it is cold today, I still want to go out.
examples.py: Suī rán jīn tiān hěn lěng, dàn shì wǒ hái shì xiǎng chū qù.

examples.zh: 虽然你忘了，但是我记得。
examples.en: Although you forgot, I remembered.
examples.py: Suī rán nǐ wàng le, dàn shì wǒ jì de.

examples.zh: 虽然这个有点儿贵，但是很好看。
examples.en: Although this is a little expensive, it looks good.
examples.py: Suī rán zhè ge yǒu diǎnr guì, dàn shì hěn hǎo kàn.

exercises.q: 翻译：Although he is very busy, he still came.
exercises.a: 虽然他很忙，但是他还是来了。
exercises.body: Although he is very busy, he still came.

exercises.q: 翻译：Although I'm tired, I'm very happy.
exercises.a: 虽然我很累，但是很高兴。
exercises.body: Although I'm tired, I'm very happy.

points.note: “虽然”提出事实，“但是”引出与预期不同的结果。
points.structureEn: suīrán + Situation, dànshì + Contrasting result = although...but...
points.noteEn: 虽然 gives a fact; 但是 gives an unexpected result.

points.name: 比较句（3）：“A 没有 B（这么/那么）+ 形容词”
points.explainEn: Use A 没有 B + adjective to mean A is not as … as B.
points.structure: A + 没有 + B +（这么/那么）+ 形容词

examples.en: Today is not as cold as yesterday.
examples.py: Jīn tiān méi yǒu zuó tiān lěng.

examples.en: I am not as tall as my older sister.
examples.py: Wǒ méi yǒu jiě jie gāo.

examples.en: This one is not as expensive as that one.
examples.py: Zhè ge méi yǒu nà ge nà me guì.

exercises.q: 翻译：This phone isn't as expensive as that one.
exercises.body: This phone isn't as expensive as that one.

exercises.q: 翻译：My Chinese isn't as good as yours.
exercises.body: My Chinese isn't as good as yours.

points.note: 这是“比”字句的常见否定比较方式。
points.structureEn: A + méiyǒu + B + (zhème / nàme) + Adjective = not as ... as...
points.noteEn: This is the common way to negate a 比 comparison.

points.name: 动词“离”
points.explainEn: Use A 离 B + far/near to talk about distance between two places or times.
points.structure: A + 离 + B + 远/近；离 + 时间 + 还有……

examples.en: My home is close to the school.
examples.py: Wǒ jiā lí xué xiào hěn jìn.

examples.en: Is this place far from the airport?
examples.py: Zhè lǐ lí jī chǎng yuǎn ma?

examples.en: There are three days until the exam.
examples.py: Lí kǎo shì hái yǒu sān tiān.

exercises.q: 翻译：The supermarket is very far from my home.
exercises.body: The supermarket is very far from my home.

exercises.q: 翻译：How many days are there until your birthday?
exercises.body: How many days are there until your birthday?

points.note: “离”可以表示空间距离，也可以表示时间距离。
points.structureEn: A + lí + B + far/near; lí + Time + hái yǒu... = distance / time remaining
points.noteEn: 离 can express distance in space or in time.

points.name: 时量补语（1）
points.explainEn: Put a duration after a verb to say how long an action lasts.
points.structure: 动词 +（了）+ 时段；V + O + V + 了 + 时段

examples.en: I waited for ten minutes.
examples.py: Wǒ děng le shí fēn zhōng.

examples.en: They studied Chinese for two years.
examples.py: Tā men xué le liǎng nián zhōng wén.

examples.en: He ran for one hour.
examples.py: Tā pǎo bù pǎo le yí ge xiǎo shí.

exercises.q: 翻译：I studied for three hours.
exercises.body: I studied for three hours.

exercises.q: 翻译：He watched TV for two hours.
exercises.a: 他看电视看了两个小时。
exercises.body: He watched TV for two hours.

points.note: 时量补语表示动作持续的时间长度。
points.structureEn: Verb + (le) + Duration; V + O + V + le + Duration
points.noteEn: A duration complement shows how long an action lasts.

points.name: 主谓谓语句
points.explainEn: A whole subject-predicate phrase can describe the main topic of the sentence.
points.structure: 大主语 + 小主语 + 谓语

examples.en: My younger brother has small hands.
examples.py: Dì di shǒu hěn xiǎo.

examples.en: He knows about this matter.
examples.py: Zhè jiàn shì tā zhī dào.

examples.en: Have you seen my schoolbag?
examples.py: Wǒ de shū bāo nǐ kàn jiàn le ma?

exercises.q: 翻译：My mom is in good health.
exercises.body: My mom is in good health.

exercises.q: 翻译：This piece of clothing has a very nice color.
exercises.body: This piece of clothing has a very nice color.

points.note: 大主语是全句话题，小主语和谓语一起说明这个话题。
points.structureEn: Main Topic + Small Subject + Predicate
points.noteEn: The big subject is the topic; the small subject + predicate comment on it.

points.name: 选择问句
points.explainEn: Use 还是 between choices in a question: “A or B?”.
points.structure: A + 还是 + B？

examples.en: Do you want tea or coffee?
examples.py: Nǐ hē chá hái shì kā fēi?

examples.en: Are you going today or tomorrow?
examples.py: Nǐ jīn tiān qù hái shì míng tiān qù?

examples.zh: 你喜欢坐地铁还是坐公交车？
examples.en: Do you prefer the subway or the bus?
examples.py: Nǐ xǐ huan zuò dì tiě hái shì zuò gōng jiāo chē?

exercises.q: 翻译：Is this yours or his?
exercises.body: Is this yours or his?

exercises.q: 翻译：Is your birthday in May or in June?
exercises.a: 你的生日是五月还是六月？
exercises.body: Is your birthday in May or in June?

points.note: 选择问句使用“还是”，通常不用“或者”。
points.structureEn: A + háishi + B? = A or B? (choice question)
points.noteEn: Choice questions use 还是, not 或者.

points.name: 固定格式“要/快/快要/就要……了”
points.explainEn: Use 要/快/快要/就要…了 for something that will happen very soon.
points.structure: 要/快/快要/就要 + 动作/变化 + 了

examples.zh: 我们下星期就要考试了。
examples.en: We are going to have an exam next week.
examples.py: Wǒ men xià xīng qī jiù yào kǎo shì le.

examples.en: The train is about to leave.
examples.py: Huǒ chē kuài kāi le.

examples.en: The food is almost ready.
examples.py: Fàn kuài yào zuò hǎo le.

exercises.q: 翻译：It is about to rain.
exercises.body: It is about to rain.

exercises.q: 翻译：The movie is about to start.
exercises.body: The movie is about to start.

exercises.q: 翻译：We are going to China next month. (use 就要)
exercises.a: 我们下个月就要去中国了。
exercises.body: We are going to China next month. (use 就要)

points.note: 有明确时间词时，教材特别强调常用“就要……了”。
points.structureEn: yào / kuài / kuàiyào / jiùyào + Action / Change + le = about to...
points.noteEn: With a specific time word, the text prefers 就要…了.

points.name: 动态助词“着”（1）：状态持续
points.explainEn: Put 着 after a verb to show an action or state continues.
points.structure: 动词 + 着

examples.en: The door is open.
examples.py: Mén kāi zhe.

examples.en: Sit here / stay sitting here.
examples.py: Nǐ zài zhèr zuò zhe.

examples.en: The light is on.
examples.py: Dēng liàng zhe.

exercises.q: 翻译：Mom is sitting on the chair.
exercises.body: Mom is sitting on the chair.

exercises.q: 翻译：He is standing at the door.
exercises.body: He is standing at the door.

points.note: 这里强调状态持续，不是“正在做某事”的进行体。
points.structureEn: Verb + zhe = continuing state / action
points.noteEn: Here it stresses a lasting state, not an action in progress.

points.name: 动态助词“着”（2）：带宾语
points.explainEn: When 着 has an object, put the object after 着.
points.structure: 动词 + 着 + 宾语

examples.en: She is wearing red clothes.
examples.py: Tā chuān zhe hóng sè de yī fu.

examples.en: It is snowing outside.
examples.py: Wài mian xià zhe xuě.

examples.en: He is holding a phone.
examples.py: Tā shǒu lǐ ná zhe shǒu jī.

exercises.q: 翻译：My younger brother is wearing his older brother's clothes.
exercises.body: My younger brother is wearing his older brother's clothes.

exercises.q: 翻译：He is holding a cup of coffee.
exercises.body: He is holding a cup of coffee.

points.note: 带宾语时的基本顺序是“动词 + 着 + 宾语”。
points.structureEn: Verb + zhe + Object
points.noteEn: With an object the order is verb + 着 + object.

points.name: 程度副词“最”
points.explainEn: Use 最 before an adjective or a feeling/preference verb to mean “the most”.
points.structure: 最 + 形容词 / 心理动词

examples.en: I like Chinese food the most.
examples.py: Wǒ zuì xǐ huan chī zhōng guó cài.

examples.en: Dad is the tallest in our family.
examples.py: Wǒ men jiā bà ba zuì gāo.

examples.en: This method is the best.
examples.py: Zhè ge bàn fǎ zuì hǎo.

exercises.q: 翻译：This one is the cheapest.
exercises.body: This one is the cheapest.

exercises.q: 翻译：Which one is the most delicious?
exercises.body: Which one is the most delicious?

points.note: “最”表示在一个范围内程度最高。
points.structureEn: zuì + Adjective / Mental verb = the most
points.noteEn: 最 marks the highest degree within a scope.

points.name: 比较句（4）：“比 + 形容词 + 多了/得多”
points.explainEn: Use 多了 or 得多 after the adjective to show a big difference.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词 + 多了/得多

examples.en: It is much colder here than in Beijing.
examples.py: Zhè lǐ bǐ běi jīng lěng duō le.

examples.zh: 坐飞机比坐火车快得多。
examples.en: Flying is much faster than taking the train.
examples.py: Zuò fēi jī bǐ zuò huǒ chē kuài de duō.

examples.zh: 这个房间比那个大多了。
examples.en: This room is much bigger than that one.
examples.py: Zhè ge fáng jiān bǐ nà ge dà duō le.

exercises.q: 翻译：The subway is much cheaper than a taxi.
exercises.a: 坐地铁比打车便宜多了。
exercises.body: The subway is much cheaper than a taxi.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older brother is much taller than me. (use 得多)
exercises.body: My older brother is much taller than me. (use 得多)

points.note: “多了/得多”表示差别比较大。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + Adjective + duō le / de duō = much more...
points.noteEn: 多了/得多 shows a large difference.

points.name: 比较句（5）：带状态补语的比较
points.explainEn: With 得-complements, 比 can come before the verb or between 得 and the adjective.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + V + 得 + 补语；A + V + 得 + 比 + B + 补语

examples.en: Mom sleeps later than I do.
examples.py: Mā ma bǐ wǒ shuì de wǎn.

examples.en: He runs faster than I do.
examples.py: Tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài.

examples.en: It rained harder yesterday than today.
examples.py: Zuó tiān bǐ jīn tiān xià de dà.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older sister gets up earlier than me.
exercises.body: My older sister gets up earlier than me.

exercises.q: 翻译：She sings better than me.
exercises.body: She sings better than me.

exercises.q: 翻译：He came earlier than me. (start with 他比我)
exercises.body: He came earlier than me. (start with 他比我)

points.note: 比较的是动作的状态时，“比”的位置有两种常见形式。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + V + de + Complement; A + V + de + bǐ + B + Complement
points.noteEn: When comparing the manner of an action, 比 has two common positions.

points.name: 比较句（6）：动词带宾语和状态补语
points.explainEn: If the verb has both an object and a 得-complement, move the object forward or repeat the verb.
points.structure: O + V + 得 + 比…；V + O + 比… + V + 得…；离合词重复动词部分

examples.en: You run faster than I do.
examples.py: Nǐ pǎo bù pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài.

examples.en: She writes Chinese characters better than I do.
examples.py: Tā hàn zì xiě de bǐ wǒ hǎo.

examples.en: He plays football better than I do.
examples.py: Tā tī zú qiú bǐ wǒ tī de hǎo.

exercises.q: 翻译：He writes Chinese characters faster than I do.
exercises.body: He writes Chinese characters faster than I do.

exercises.q: 翻译：My older sister cooks better than my mom.
exercises.a: 姐姐做饭做得比妈妈好。
exercises.body: My older sister cooks better than my mom.

exercises.q: 翻译：He speaks Chinese better than I do. (start with 他中文)
exercises.body: He speaks Chinese better than I do. (start with 他中文)

points.note: 重点是避免“动词+宾语+得”的错误顺序。
points.structureEn: O + V + de + bǐ...; V + O + bǐ... + V + de...; repeat the verb part of a separable verb
points.noteEn: The point is to avoid the wrong order verb + object + 得.

points.name: 双宾语句（2）：“拿/送/卖 + 给 + 人 + 东西”
points.explainEn: Use 拿/送/卖 + 给 + person + thing to show something is given, handed, or sold to someone.
points.structure: 主语 + 拿/送/卖 + 给 + 人 + 东西

examples.en: She handed me a glass of water.
examples.py: Tā ná gěi wǒ yì bēi shuǐ.

examples.en: He sold me a Chinese book.
examples.py: Tā mài gěi wǒ yì běn zhōng wén shū.

examples.en: I gave the teacher some flowers.
examples.py: Wǒ sòng gěi lǎo shī yí shù huā.

exercises.q: 翻译：I gave my younger sister a book.
exercises.body: I gave my younger sister a book.

exercises.q: 翻译：Mom gave me a watch. (use 送给)
exercises.body: Mom gave me a watch. (use 送给)

points.note: 第一册“双宾语句（1）”主要学“给 + 人 + 东西”；这里增加“拿给、送给、卖给”。
points.structureEn: Subject + ná / sòng / mài + gěi + Person + Thing
points.noteEn: Book 1 taught 给 + person + thing; here add 拿给/送给/卖给.

points.name: 比较句（7）：表示具体差值
points.explainEn: Put a number-measure phrase after the adjective to show the exact difference.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词 + 数量短语

examples.en: My older sister is three years older than me.
examples.py: Jiě jie bǐ wǒ dà sān suì.

examples.zh: 今天的词比昨天多十个。
examples.en: There are ten more words today than yesterday.
examples.py: Jīn tiān de cí bǐ zuó tiān duō shí ge.

examples.zh: 坐飞机比坐火车快五个小时。
examples.en: Flying is five hours faster than taking the train.
examples.py: Zuò fēi jī bǐ zuò huǒ chē kuài wǔ ge xiǎo shí.

exercises.q: 翻译：This one is ten yuan cheaper than that one.
exercises.a: 这个比那个便宜十块钱。
exercises.body: This one is ten yuan cheaper than that one.

exercises.q: 翻译：This pair of trousers is fifty yuan more expensive than that pair.
exercises.a: 这条裤子比那条贵五十块钱。
exercises.body: This pair of trousers is fifty yuan more expensive than that pair.

points.note: 数量短语说明“到底差多少”。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + Adjective + Number-Measure Phrase = exact difference
points.noteEn: A quantity phrase says exactly how big the difference is.

points.name: 比较句（8）：表示小差别“一点儿/一些”
points.explainEn: Use 一点儿 or 一些 after the adjective to show a small difference.
points.structure: A + 比 + B + 形容词 + 一点儿/一些

examples.en: My older sister is a little taller than me.
examples.py: Jiě jie bǐ wǒ gāo yì diǎnr.

examples.en: This one is a little more expensive than that one.
examples.py: Zhè ge bǐ nà ge guì yì diǎnr.

examples.zh: 那间教室比这间大一些。
examples.en: That classroom is a little bigger than this one.
examples.py: Nà jiān jiào shì bǐ zhè jiān dà yì xiē.

exercises.q: 翻译：Today is a little colder than yesterday.
exercises.body: Today is a little colder than yesterday.

exercises.q: 翻译：This piece of clothing is a bit nicer-looking than that one. (use 一些)
exercises.a: 这件衣服比那件好看一些。
exercises.body: This piece of clothing is a bit nicer-looking than that one. (use 一些)

points.note: 和第12课“多了/得多”相反，“一点儿/一些”表示差别较小。
points.structureEn: A + bǐ + B + Adjective + yìdiǎnr / yìxiē = a small difference
points.noteEn: Opposite to 多了/得多, 一点儿/一些 shows a small difference.

lessons.title: 一个人过年多没意思啊

points.name: 存现句（2）：“地点 + V着 + 人/物”
points.explainEn: Use place + V着 + person/thing to say someone or something exists in a place in a continuing state.
points.structure: 地点 + 动词 + 着 + 不定的人/物

examples.en: There is a person standing at the door.
examples.py: Mén kǒu zhàn zhe yí ge rén.

examples.en: There is a book lying on the table.
examples.py: Zhuō zi shàng fàng zhe yì běn shū.

examples.en: There are many students sitting in the classroom.
examples.py: Jiào shì lǐ zuò zhe hěn duō xué sheng.

exercises.q: 翻译：There is a child sitting on the chair.
exercises.body: There is a child sitting on the chair.

exercises.q: 翻译：There is a name written on the book.
exercises.body: There is a name written on the book.

points.note: 第一册存现句（1）用“有”；这里学习“地点 + 动词着 + 人/物”。
points.structureEn: Place + Verb + zhe + Indefinite person / thing = there is/are...
points.noteEn: Book 1 used 有; here learn place + verb+着 + person/thing.

points.name: 程度副词“多”表示程度很高
points.explainEn: Use 多 + adjective + 啊 to exclaim “how / so…!”.
points.structure: 多 + 形容词 + 啊！

examples.zh: 一个人过年多没意思啊！
examples.en: How boring it is to spend Spring Festival alone!
examples.py: Yí ge rén guò nián duō méi yì si a!

examples.en: How beautiful it is here!
examples.py: Zhè lǐ duō piào liang a!

examples.en: How nice it is to eat together!
examples.py: Dà jiā yì qǐ chī fàn duō hǎo a!

exercises.q: 翻译：How delicious this dish is!
exercises.body: How delicious this dish is!

exercises.q: 翻译：How cold it is today!
exercises.body: How cold it is today!

points.note: 这里的“多”不是“多少”，而是感叹程度很高。
points.structureEn: duō + Adjective + a! = How / so ...!
points.noteEn: Here 多 isn't "how many"; it's an exclamation of high degree.

points.name: 复合趋向补语
points.explainEn: Use V + direction word + 来/去 to show a more specific direction.
points.structure: V + 上/下/进/出/回/过 + 来/去

examples.en: Please come in.
examples.py: Qǐng zǒu jìn lái.

examples.en: He ran out.
examples.py: Tā pǎo chū qù le.

examples.en: I brought the book back.
examples.py: Wǒ bǎ shū ná huí lái le.

exercises.q: 翻译：He ran back.
exercises.body: He ran back.

exercises.q: 翻译：He walked over (toward us).
exercises.body: He walked over (toward us).

points.note: “来”朝说话人方向，“去”离开说话人方向。
points.structureEn: V + shàng / xià / jìn / chū / huí / guò + lái / qù = compound direction
points.noteEn: 来 is toward the speaker; 去 is away from the speaker.

points.name: 动量补语（1）：动作次数
points.explainEn: Use number + 次 after a verb to count how many times an action happens.
points.structure: 动词 + 数字 + 次 (+ 宾语)

examples.en: I have been to China twice.
examples.py: Wǒ qù guo zhōng guó liǎng cì.

examples.en: I watched this movie three times.
examples.py: Wǒ kàn le sān cì zhè ge diàn yǐng.

examples.en: How many times have you been to Beijing?
examples.py: Nǐ qù guo běi jīng jǐ cì?

exercises.q: 翻译：He has taken a plane twice.
exercises.body: He has taken a plane twice.

exercises.q: 翻译：She has been to my home twice.
exercises.body: She has been to my home twice.

points.note: 本点先掌握“次”表示动作发生的次数。
points.structureEn: Verb + Number + cì (+ Object) = number of times
points.noteEn: First master 次 for the number of times an action happens.

points.name: 动量补语（2）：宾语和次数的位置
points.explainEn: The position of the object changes with different kinds of objects when you use a frequency complement.
points.structure: 事物：V + 次数 + O；代词：V + 代词 + 次数

examples.en: I watched this movie twice.
examples.py: Wǒ kàn le liǎng cì zhè ge diàn yǐng.

examples.en: I looked for him three times.
examples.py: Wǒ zhǎo le tā sān cì.

examples.zh: 老师叫了我的名字两次。
examples.en: The teacher called my name twice.
examples.py: Lǎo shī jiào le wǒ de míng zi liǎng cì.

exercises.q: 翻译：I called him three times.
exercises.body: I called him three times.

exercises.q: 翻译：I asked him twice.
exercises.body: I asked him twice.

points.note: 人名、地点名等位置较灵活；代词通常放在次数补语前。
points.structureEn: Thing: V + Frequency + O; Pronoun: V + Pronoun + Frequency
points.noteEn: Names/places are flexible; pronouns go before the frequency complement.

points.name: “有”字句（2）：“有 + 数量”表示达到某数量
points.explainEn: Use 有 + a number/amount to mean “reach / have as much as…”.
points.structure: 主语 + 有 + 数量 +（时间/年龄等）

examples.en: I have not returned home for a year.
examples.py: Wǒ yǒu yì nián méi huí guó le.

examples.en: Is she already ten years old this year?
examples.py: Tā jīn nián yǒu shí suì le ma?

examples.zh: 我有一个月没给家里打电话了。
examples.en: I have not called home for a month.
examples.py: Wǒ yǒu yí ge yuè méi gěi jiā lǐ dǎ diàn huà le.

exercises.q: 翻译：I haven't seen him for a week.
exercises.a: 我有一个星期没看见他了。
exercises.body: I haven't seen him for a week.

exercises.q: 翻译：I haven't eaten dumplings for a month. (use 有)
exercises.a: 我有两个星期没吃饺子了。
exercises.body: I haven't eaten dumplings for a month. (use 有)

points.note: 第一册“有（1）”主要表示拥有/存在；这里的“有”表示数量达到某个程度。
points.structureEn: Subject + yǒu + Amount + (time / age, etc.) = reach / have as much as...
points.noteEn: Book 1's 有 meant have/exist; here 有 means reaching a certain amount.
